exposure: Administration of antenatal corticosteroids (ACS) to mothers at risk for late preterm delivery
Change in obstetric policy regarding ACS administration
cohort: Late preterm (34-36 6/7 weeks) neonates delivered at NYU Langone Medical Center, excluding those born to mothers with pre-gestational diabetes, multiple gestations, or congenital/genetic abnormalities, and those whose mothers already received ACS.
finding: A new policy advising antenatal corticosteroid administration for late preterm delivery significantly increased ACS use, reducing NICU admissions and respiratory support needs in LPT neonates, but also increased the incidence of hypoglycemia.
